scope: Original I1 and I2, and direct risks introduced by the single fix diff.

findings.evidence: Before publishing the launch receipt, main checks every selected leaf and both control names using no-follow stat relative to a bound parent. Existing non-directories and directory identity mismatches fail closed. fwalk propagates access errors and the visit set must cover every observed directory. Exact missing, zero-extra, and preexisting leaf checks all precede publication. The former directory/dangling-receipt counterexamples and real unreadable-subtree control now stop before any fixture file or directory changes.

The stage and runtime root descriptors are opened independently, beginning at /. Descent uses O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, with observed (device, inode) checked before use. Directory creation and exclusive no-follow leaf creation are relative to the held parent descriptor. Parent identity is checked after writes; root names and the runtime inventory are rechecked before returning success. Controlled root and parent replacements stopped without writing a file into their replacements. A competing final leaf remained byte-identical.

independent_verification.coverage: Real temporary directories, occupied leaves/control names, inaccessible subtree, late leaf collision, changed root and parent, successful tiny restore and read-only verification on healthy/damaged fixtures. Payload decoding and snapshot selection were replaced with fixture data.
independent_verification.scope_limit: This review does not claim atomic multi-file restoration or protection from arbitrary uncooperative directory renames during a system call. A failure after launch retains partial evidence.

live_status: No cloud access, live install, Lean execution, kernel command or runtime compatibility acceptance. This verdict applies only to the reviewed data-restoration code.
